entries.reason: product_doc_extractor is stdlib + boto3 only by design (no powertools, cannot import shared; its module docstring) and keeps marked copies of is_conditional_check_failure and the invocation-cost helpers

operator scripts: (1) the CloudFormation output lookups stay in each script because scripts/audit/stack_outputs.py resolves a helper's OutputKey reads only within the file that defines it, so one imported helper would hide every caller's output key from that gate; (2) parse_args declares each script's own flags (env defaults, table names, --dry-run/--apply wording)

projects_handler._validated_source_ids (document ids: keyed ownership read per id, ValidationError, 'names more than N documents') vs radar_brands._domains (host names: URL/www stripping and a regex, ValueError the brand-list route words as '{brand} radar_domains may hold at most N domains'); a common helper would take the parser, the exception and both messages as parameters

wire DTOs of two unrelated records (a voting session's facilitator view with derived row/state fields and created_by left out on purpose; an uploaded product document); equal only in being field-by-field dict projections with defaults

optional-field validators whose 400 wording and rules are each route's contract: form fields checked unstripped ('must be a string'), company-context lists ('may hold at most N entries'), dimension config lists raising ValueError ('At most N <what> are allowed'), draft intent text ('must be text' / 'is too long (at most N characters)', stripped after the check), Prioritization axis text (stripped before the check, '' -> None); one helper would need the type, exception, strip order and both messages as parameters
